actionType.description: Which form to render: releaseToEvaluation, individualEvaluation, consensus, priceDetermination, awardDecision, clarification

solicitationId.description: Solicitation number; key into Data Fabric

evaluatorSlot.description: Evaluator panel slot (1-3) for individual evaluation

recommendedAwardee.description: Offeror recommended by the decision writer

decision.description: Routing decision: Release/Cancel (release), Approve/Reconvene (consensus), Proceed/Cancel (price), Submitted (evaluation, clarification), Signed (award)

notes.description: Rationale, price reasonableness determination, or clarification notes

payload.description: Structured result: evaluator ratings (JSON), consensus ratings (JSON) or Chair questions, or the signed SSDD text

awardee.description: Offeror selected by the Source Selection Authority

draft.description: Work in progress saved without submitting (JSON written and read by the form)
